sentences.en: The leisure industry is sinking more money into new resorts.
sentences.zh: 休闲产业正投入更多资金建设新的度假村。

sentences.en: During the bubble, people dreamed of a life of leisure.
sentences.zh: 在泡沫时期，人们梦想着悠闲的生活。

sentences.en: What passes for leisure in our society is actually time-consuming.
sentences.zh: 我们社会所谓的闲暇时间其实很耗费时间。
